plan: reports/2026-10-26_plan_regating-without-cues.md, Amendment 2. Filed before the run; never edited after.

measurements.R_near: run.py's nearest rule again (8 training windows nearest in g0); gate A0
measurements.R_near_cue: the same with the 8 nearest drawn from training windows with the window's own cue (not on emoticon, whose rarer trigger tokens have fewer than 8 training windows)
measurements.same_cue: share of the 8 nearest training windows (unrestricted) holding the window's cue; reported
measurements.dup: share of held-out windows whose tokens equal a training window's
measurements.dist_ratio: median held-out distance to the nearest training window over the median training distance to the nearest other training window; reported

gates.A0: every state: |R_near - E35's R_near| <= 0.001; emoticon first; fail: stop

predictions.blind_to: the trigger position only; one fine-tune seed; one 67M model; copy and the cipher share one window set, the two 32-cue ' of' states another, so the four 32-cue states are two input sets

predictions.rule: every 32-cue state: same_cue >= 0.9 ('the nearest windows share the cue')
